blocks.content: Congratulations on completing this path! Job well done!

You have successfully:

- Understood how the notification policy tree routes alerts based on labels
- Created a notification policy with label matchers and a contact point
- Configured grouping so related alert instances arrive in a single notification
- Set group wait, group interval, and repeat interval timing

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following paths after you complete this one:

- [Create a silence](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/create-silence/) to temporarily stop notifications
- [Configure a mute timing](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/configure-mute-timing/) to set recurring quiet windows
